question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Tooth and nail**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "With full force or vigour". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Tooth and nail"** means to fight or work with full force and determination, often in a very intense or vigorous manner. (पूरी ताकत और दृढ़ता से लड़ना या काम करना।) • **Example:** The students fought tooth and nail to get their demands heard by the administration. • **Explanation:** The phrase symbolizes the use of all available resources (teeth and nails) to achieve a goal or to defend oneself. (यह मुहावरा हर संभव संसाधन का उपयोग करने का प्रतीक है।) • **Example:** She defended her position tooth and nail against her opponents. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Without planning (बिना योजना के)** • **Explanation:** This suggests doing something spontaneously or without prior preparation. • **Example:** They went on a trip without planning and had to face many difficulties. • **Option 3: Secretly and quietly (गुप्त रूप से और चुपचाप)** • **Explanation:** This refers to doing something in a secretive and silent manner. • **Example:** She left the room secretly and quietly, without anyone noticing. • **Option 4: Half-heartedly (आधे मन से)** • **Explanation:** This refers to doing something without much enthusiasm or effort. • **Example:** He completed the assignment half-heartedly, and it showed in his work. 36:T9da, The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e., **Stimulating**.
